dialogues.jp: 目覚ましより先に、目が覚めた。
dialogues.en: My eyes opened before the alarm clock rang,
dialogues.text: My eyes opened before the alarm clock rang,

dialogues.jp: こんなことって、今までないよな。
dialogues.en: That's the first time this had happened.
dialogues.text: That's the first time this had happened.

dialogues.jp: よっぽど、環に会えるのが楽しみなのかな。
dialogues.en: I was too excited at the prospect of seeing Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I was too excited at the prospect of seeing Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 先に行って、待っててやるか……。
dialogues.en: I'd go earlier and wait...
dialogues.text: I'd go earlier and wait...

dialogues.jp: 俺は起き上がり、制服に着替えた。
dialogues.en: I got up, and changed into my school uniform.
dialogues.text: I got up, and changed into my school uniform.

dialogues.jp: やっぱ、まだ早いんだな……。
dialogues.en: I really am early...
dialogues.text: I really am early...

dialogues.jp: 学校に来る学生達はまばらだ。
dialogues.en: There were so few students at school.
dialogues.text: There were so few students at school.

dialogues.jp:
この時間に登校している奴らは、部活に入って
るヤツがほとんどだ。
dialogues.en:
The only people who would come now are the ones with club
activities anyway.
dialogues.text:
The only people who would come now are the ones with club
activities anyway.

dialogues.jp: ご苦労なことだ。
dialogues.en: An admirable show of dedication, I suppose.
dialogues.text: An admirable show of dedication, I suppose.

dialogues.jp: ふと、巫女部の事を思い出す。
dialogues.en:
The clubs suddenly reminded me of the situation with the
Miko Club.
dialogues.text:
The clubs suddenly reminded me of the situation with the
Miko Club.

dialogues.jp: 環になんて言おう。
dialogues.en: How will I explain it to her...
dialogues.text: How will I explain it to her...

dialogues.jp:
部員が辞めてしまったことを伝えるのは、正直
心苦しい。
dialogues.en:
It'd break her heart when she finds out that most of the
members quit.
dialogues.text:
It'd break her heart when she finds out that most of the
members quit.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、本人が部室に行ってから知るよりは、
ある程度伝えておいた方がいいだろう。
dialogues.en:
Maybe it's better to let her find out when she walks into
the clubroom herself.
dialogues.text:
Maybe it's better to let her find out when she walks into
the clubroom herself.

dialogues.jp:
半分は、環を無理矢理連れて帰った俺の責任で
もあるわけだし……。
dialogues.en:
It's partly my responsibility as well, since I was the one
who basically forced her home...
dialogues.text:
It's partly my responsibility as well, since I was the one
who basically forced her home...

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、言わないとな……。
dialogues.en: I don't think I can tell her...
dialogues.text: I don't think I can tell her...

dialogues.jp:
待ち合わせ時間近くになり、並木道をぶらつい
たが、環は来ない。
dialogues.en:
As the meeting time drew closer, Tamaki was still nowhere to
be seen.
dialogues.text:
As the meeting time drew closer, Tamaki was still nowhere to
be seen.

dialogues.jp: もう少し待てば来るだろう。
dialogues.en: She'd come if I wait a little longer, surely.
dialogues.text: She'd come if I wait a little longer, surely.

dialogues.jp: 今日の朝は、いつもより多く一緒にいられる。
dialogues.en: This morning, more than ever, I wanted to be with her.
dialogues.text: This morning, more than ever, I wanted to be with her.

dialogues.jp:
たった５分のことだが、それが妙に嬉しく感じ
る。
dialogues.en:
It'd be nice to give her the line she always gives me, about
getting here 5 minutes ago...
dialogues.text:
It'd be nice to give her the line she always gives me, about
getting here 5 minutes ago...

dialogues.jp: 俺は逸る気持ちを抑えながら、環を待つ。
dialogues.en: I curbed my unneccessary thoughts, and waited.
dialogues.text: I curbed my unneccessary thoughts, and waited.

dialogues.jp:
いつもなら、５分前にはその姿を見せているも
のの、今日は時間を過ぎても、環は来なかった。
dialogues.en:
She'd almost always show up exactly 5 minutes before, but
time continued passing by, with no Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
She'd almost always show up exactly 5 minutes before, but
time continued passing by, with no Tamaki.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩」
dialogues.en: "Askaura-senpai!"
dialogues.text: "Askaura-senpai!"

dialogues.jp: 校舎に入ろうとすると、美春が話しかけてきた。
dialogues.en: Miharu called out as she entered the school building.
dialogues.text: Miharu called out as she entered the school building.

dialogues.jp: 「よお」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ええ！　どうしちゃったんですか？　こんな
　に朝早く！　雨降りますよ」
dialogues.en:
"Huhhh, what are you doing here so early? You're going to
make it rain!"
dialogues.text:
"Huhhh, what are you doing here so early? You're going to
make it rain!"

dialogues.jp: 美春は笑いながら毒を吐く。
dialogues.en: Miharu burst into a fit of giggles at her own joke.
dialogues.text: Miharu burst into a fit of giggles at her own joke.

dialogues.jp: 「うるせえ」
dialogues.en: "Oh shut up."
dialogues.text: "Oh shut up."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「誰かと待ち合わせですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you waiting for someone?"
dialogues.text: "Are you waiting for someone?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……まあな」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ああ！」
dialogues.en: "Ahhh!"
dialogues.text: "Ahhh!"

dialogues.jp: 美春はひらめいたようにポンっと手を打ち、
dialogues.en:
Miharu punched her palm with her fist, in a burst of
enlightenment.
dialogues.text:
Miharu punched her palm with her fist, in a burst of
enlightenment.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あの、時をかける少女ですね？」
dialogues.en: "It's that girl who can control time, right?"
dialogues.text: "It's that girl who can control time, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Huh!?"
dialogues.text: "Huh!?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は美春の言う意味が分からず、思わず聞き返
す。
dialogues.en: Miharu's guess completely flew over my head.
dialogues.text: Miharu's guess completely flew over my head.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、あの未来が読めるっていう、胡ノ宮先
　輩のことですよ」
dialogues.en: "That girl that can see the future, Konomiya-senpai!"
dialogues.text: "That girl that can see the future, Konomiya-senpai!"

dialogues.jp: ……変なキャッチフレーズ入れんなよ。
dialogues.en: ......Don't use stupid catchphrases.
dialogues.text: ......Don't use stupid catchphrases.

dialogues.jp: 「まあな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: しかし、一応は肯定しておく。
dialogues.en: But I'd confirm it anyway.
dialogues.text: But I'd confirm it anyway.

dialogues.jp: 環を待っているのは事実だし。
dialogues.en: It is true that I'm waiting for Tamaki.
dialogues.text: It is true that I'm waiting for Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 美春はニヤニヤ笑って、
dialogues.en: A little grin formed up Miharu's face.
dialogues.text: A little grin formed up Miharu's face.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ふーん。そうですか。では、逢引を邪魔して
　も悪いので、美春は先に行きますね。じゃ、
　先輩さよならでーす」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm, I see. I hate being a third wheel, so I'd head off.
Later!"
dialogues.text:
"Hmm, I see. I hate being a third wheel, so I'd head off.
Later!"

dialogues.jp: と、風のように去っていく。
dialogues.en: She ran off, faster than the wind.
dialogues.text: She ran off, faster than the wind.

dialogues.jp: やれやれ……。
dialogues.en: Hoo boy...
dialogues.text: Hoo boy...

dialogues.jp: 俺と環のこともちょっとずつ知られてるんだな。
dialogues.en:
The relationship between Tamaki and I seems to be well-known
now.
dialogues.text:
The relationship between Tamaki and I seems to be well-known
now.

dialogues.jp: 事実、付き合ってるわけだから良いけど。
dialogues.en: In reality, I suppose it's pretty accurate.
dialogues.text: In reality, I suppose it's pretty accurate.

dialogues.jp: ……それにしても。
dialogues.en: ...Speaking of which.
dialogues.text: ...Speaking of which.

dialogues.jp: 遅い。
dialogues.en: She's late.
dialogues.text: She's late.

dialogues.jp: 始業５分前だ。
dialogues.en: Lessons start in 5 minutes, too.
dialogues.text: Lessons start in 5 minutes, too.

dialogues.jp: そういえば、前も遅れてきた時があったな。
dialogues.en: Now that I think of it, she's only been late once before.
dialogues.text: Now that I think of it, she's only been late once before.

dialogues.jp: あの時も、体調が悪かったみたいだけど……。
dialogues.en: When she was suffering from poor health...
dialogues.text: When she was suffering from poor health...

dialogues.jp: ひょっとして、実は治ってないとか？
dialogues.en: Could it be that she's not fully recovered?
dialogues.text: Could it be that she's not fully recovered?

dialogues.jp: それとも、途中で事故にあったとか……。
dialogues.en: Or maybe she met an accident on the way...
dialogues.text: Or maybe she met an accident on the way...

dialogues.jp: いや、それは無いだろう。
dialogues.en: Nah, that can't be.
dialogues.text: Nah, that can't be.

dialogues.jp: この時間、車の交通量は少ないし。
dialogues.en: There's nearly no traffic at this time of the day.
dialogues.text: There's nearly no traffic at this time of the day.

dialogues.jp: そして、環を待っている間に、
dialogues.en: While pondering the possibilities,
dialogues.text: While pondering the possibilities,

dialogues.jp: ──キーンコーンカーンコーン
dialogues.en: --*ding dong, ding dong*
dialogues.text: --*ding dong, ding dong*

dialogues.jp: 予鈴が鳴る。
dialogues.en: The first bell rang.
dialogues.text: The first bell rang.

dialogues.jp: ……ひょっとしたら、もう先に行ってるとか。
dialogues.en: ...Maybe she went in ahead.
dialogues.text: ...Maybe she went in ahead.

dialogues.jp:
そんなことはない、と思いながらも念のため校
舎に入る。
dialogues.en:
It was illogical, but I couldn't give up hope till I saw it
for myself.
dialogues.text:
It was illogical, but I couldn't give up hope till I saw it
for myself.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は１年３組の教室を覗きに行く。
dialogues.en: I entered the classroom for class 1, group 1.
dialogues.text: I entered the classroom for class 1, group 1.

dialogues.jp: しかし、そこには環の姿は無い。
dialogues.en: But her figure was nowhere to be found.
dialogues.text: But her figure was nowhere to be found.

dialogues.jp: 俺は教室に入ろうとしている男子学生に、
dialogues.en: I approached a nearby male student.
dialogues.text: I approached a nearby male student.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、胡ノ宮って来てないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, has Konomiya come to class yet?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, has Konomiya come to class yet?"

dialogues.jp: と尋ねる。
dialogues.en: I asked nervously.
dialogues.text: I asked nervously.

dialogues.jp: 男子学生は、環の席を見て、
dialogues.en: He took a quick glace at Tamaki's desk.
dialogues.text: He took a quick glace at Tamaki's desk.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student 1
dialogues.jp: 「まだ来てないみたいだけど……」
dialogues.en: "It seems like she hasn't..."
dialogues.text: "It seems like she hasn't..."

dialogues.jp: と、教えてくれる。
dialogues.en: And revealed what he knew.
dialogues.text: And revealed what he knew.

dialogues.jp: 嫌な胸騒ぎがする。
dialogues.en: An uneasy feeling started to creep into me.
dialogues.text: An uneasy feeling started to creep into me.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、環に何かあったのかな？
dialogues.en: Did something really happen to her?
dialogues.text: Did something really happen to her?

dialogues.jp: 俺は急ぎ足で、元来た道を戻り始めた。
dialogues.en: I ran off, and back towards where we'd promised to meet.
dialogues.text: I ran off, and back towards where we'd promised to meet.

dialogues.jp: もう一度、待ち合わせ場所に戻る。
dialogues.en: But when I reached there,
dialogues.text: But when I reached there,

dialogues.jp: やはり、いない。
dialogues.en: She wasn't there either.
dialogues.text: She wasn't there either.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ダッシュで走り出す。
dialogues.en: I continued running.
dialogues.text: I continued running.

dialogues.en: "Damnit!!"
dialogues.text: "Damnit!!"

dialogues.jp: 長い石段を駆け上がる。
dialogues.en: I dashed up the stone steps as fast as I could.
dialogues.text: I dashed up the stone steps as fast as I could.

dialogues.jp: 俺の焦る気持ちを、わざと邪魔してる気がする。
dialogues.en:
I put all my pent-up feelings into energy as my feet pounded
into the steps.
dialogues.text:
I put all my pent-up feelings into energy as my feet pounded
into the steps.

dialogues.jp:
上っても上っても、まだまだ延々と続く気がす
る。
dialogues.en:
The higher and higher I went, the more it seemed like the
steps would never end.
dialogues.text:
The higher and higher I went, the more it seemed like the
steps would never end.

dialogues.jp:
やっとの思いで上りつめると、神社はとてもひっ
そりとしている。
dialogues.en:
After what seemed like ages, I finally caught sight of the
shrine.
dialogues.text:
After what seemed like ages, I finally caught sight of the
shrine.

dialogues.jp:
俺の荒い息遣いと、波打つ鼓動が、境内にこだ
まするように聞こえる。
dialogues.en:
Breathing heavily, and heart racing, I entered the shrine
grounds.
dialogues.text:
Breathing heavily, and heart racing, I entered the shrine
grounds.

dialogues.jp: 環、どこだ……。
dialogues.en: Tamaki, where are you...
dialogues.text: Tamaki, where are you...

dialogues.jp:
ひょっとしたら、入れ違いで学校に行っている
かもしれないとも思うが、
dialogues.en: It could be that we'd passed each other and didn't notice...
dialogues.text: It could be that we'd passed each other and didn't notice...

dialogues.jp:
来る途中で会わなかったので、まだ神社にいる
はずだ。
dialogues.en:
But I didn't see her on the way to school or back, so she
must still be at the shrine.
dialogues.text:
But I didn't see her on the way to school or back, so she
must still be at the shrine.

dialogues.jp: 何だか、とてつもなく嫌な胸騒ぎに襲われる。
dialogues.en:
As I thought more about it, the bad feeling in me grew
larger.
dialogues.text:
As I thought more about it, the bad feeling in me grew
larger.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、境内を探し始める。
dialogues.en: I started to search the grounds.
dialogues.text: I started to search the grounds.

dialogues.jp: ｛まき／槙｝の木、手水舎、拝殿……。
dialogues.en: The kozue tree, the fountain, the hall of worship...
dialogues.text: The kozue tree, the fountain, the hall of worship...

dialogues.jp: そして、社務所に入る。
dialogues.en: Finally, I checked the shrine office.
dialogues.text: Finally, I checked the shrine office.

dialogues.jp:
するとそこには、巫女装束で倒れている環がい
る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was there, in her Miko outfit, lying on the floor.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was there, in her Miko outfit, lying on the floor.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki!"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は靴を脱いで急いで上がり、環の肩をゆする。
dialogues.en:
I hurriedly thew my bag onto the floor, and grabbed her
shoulders.
dialogues.text:
I hurriedly thew my bag onto the floor, and grabbed her
shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
しかし環は、気を失っているのか、全く気づか
ない。
dialogues.en: She seemed to be unconscious, and didn't notice my touch.
dialogues.text: She seemed to be unconscious, and didn't notice my touch.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、しっかりしろ。おい！！」
dialogues.en: "Oy, get a hold on yourself, hey!"
dialogues.text: "Oy, get a hold on yourself, hey!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は環の頬を軽くたたくが、反応が無い。
dialogues.en: I slapped her cheeks lightly, but there was no response.
dialogues.text: I slapped her cheeks lightly, but there was no response.

dialogues.jp: 「……いったいどうしたっていうんだ！」
dialogues.en: "...What the hell happened to you!"
dialogues.text: "...What the hell happened to you!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は急いで電話に駆け寄り、１１９番する。
dialogues.en: I hurried over to the phone, dialing 119 as fast as I could.
dialogues.text: I hurried over to the phone, dialing 119 as fast as I could.

dialogues.jp:
「もしもし！　救急車お願いします！　急病人
　なんです！　お願いします！　早く！」
dialogues.en:
"Hello!? Please send an ambulance over immediately! It's an
emergency! Please, hurry!"
dialogues.text:
"Hello!? Please send an ambulance over immediately! It's an
emergency! Please, hurry!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、電話の相手に必死に環の様子を伝える。
dialogues.en:
I desperately explained to the receiver about Tamaki's
condition.
dialogues.text:
I desperately explained to the receiver about Tamaki's
condition.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、自分でも何を言っているのか、きちんと
説明できてるのか、わからない。
dialogues.en:
Although I didn't know how to explain what she was going
through clearly.
dialogues.text:
Although I didn't know how to explain what she was going
through clearly.

dialogues.jp: やがて。
dialogues.en: Soon after,
dialogues.text: Soon after,

dialogues.jp: 救急車のサイレンの音が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: The siren of an ambulance became audible.
dialogues.text: The siren of an ambulance became audible.

dialogues.jp: 救急隊員が、担架を持って中に上がってくる。
dialogues.en: The first-aid people carried Tamaki onto a strecher.
dialogues.text: The first-aid people carried Tamaki onto a strecher.

dialogues.jp:
環の脈を取ったり、俺から様子を聞くのだが、
俺は自分がきちんと対応できているのか、わか
らない。
dialogues.en:
They took her pulse and asked me questions about her
condition, but I couldn't answer accurately.
dialogues.text:
They took her pulse and asked me questions about her
condition, but I couldn't answer accurately.

dialogues.jp:
冷静になろうとすればするほど、頭の中は空回
り、カラカラと音を立てている。
dialogues.en:
I tried my best to remain calm, but my head was running
circles, not helped by the siren blare.
dialogues.text:
I tried my best to remain calm, but my head was running
circles, not helped by the siren blare.

dialogues.jp: やがて、環は救急車に運ばれる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was quickly carried into the ambulance.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was quickly carried into the ambulance.

dialogues.speaker: First-Aid Man
dialogues.jp: 「さあ、あなたも早く乗ってください」
dialogues.en: "You too, please get in."
dialogues.text: "You too, please get in."

dialogues.jp: と、促され俺は車に乗り込む。
dialogues.en: He urged me onto the ambulance.
dialogues.text: He urged me onto the ambulance.

dialogues.jp: 救急車の中で、俺は必死に環に呼びかける。
dialogues.en: Inside, I frantically tried to talk to her.
dialogues.text: Inside, I frantically tried to talk to her.

dialogues.jp: 「環、しっかりしろ！」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki, just hold on!"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki, just hold on!"

dialogues.jp:
酸素マスクをつけられ、環はひっそりと息をし
ているだけだ。
dialogues.en:
They had strapped an oxygen mask over her mouth, making her
silent breathing apparent.
dialogues.text:
They had strapped an oxygen mask over her mouth, making her
silent breathing apparent.

dialogues.jp: 機械の音が、無機質に俺の頭に鳴り響く。
dialogues.en:
The beeping of machinery around revereberated around my
head.
dialogues.text:
The beeping of machinery around revereberated around my
head.

dialogues.jp: 「環！　死ぬなよ！」
dialogues.en: "Don't die, Tamaki!"
dialogues.text: "Don't die, Tamaki!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は環の手を握り締め、叫ぶように呼びかける。
dialogues.en: I grasped her hand tightly, calling out to her.
dialogues.text: I grasped her hand tightly, calling out to her.

dialogues.jp:
呼びかけを止めてしまうと、本当にそのままど
こかへ行ってしまいそうな気がした。
dialogues.en:
As my shout disappeared into the air, I hoped that it didn't
fall on deaf ears.
dialogues.text:
As my shout disappeared into the air, I hoped that it didn't
fall on deaf ears.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki, Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki, Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、まるで人形のように深く眠っている。
dialogues.en: She was in such a deep state, she looked just like a doll,
dialogues.text: She was in such a deep state, she looked just like a doll,

dialogues.jp: 「環、目を覚ましてくれ」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki, open your eyes!"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki, open your eyes!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は更に手を強く握る。
dialogues.en: My grip on her hand tightened.
dialogues.text: My grip on her hand tightened.

dialogues.jp:
喉がカラカラで、｛かす／掠｝れてしまって、きちんと環
の耳に届いているのか不安になる。
dialogues.en: My throat was dry and parched, making my voice hoarse.
dialogues.text: My throat was dry and parched, making my voice hoarse.

dialogues.jp: 何で、何でこんなことに……！
dialogues.en: Why did this have to happen...!
dialogues.text: Why did this have to happen...!

dialogues.jp: 自分に対する無力さに腹が立つ。
dialogues.en: My anger at my uselessness slowly built up.
dialogues.text: My anger at my uselessness slowly built up.

dialogues.jp: 「お願いだ……っく」
dialogues.en: "Please... please..."
dialogues.text: "Please... please..."

dialogues.jp: 環の手を、自分の頭へと持っていく。
dialogues.en: I brought her hand up to my face.
dialogues.text: I brought her hand up to my face.

dialogues.jp: 「お願いだ……環！」
dialogues.en: "Please open your eyes... Tamaki!"
dialogues.text: "Please open your eyes... Tamaki!"

dialogues.jp: ◆環が倒れた日◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Day Tamaki Collapsed?◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Day Tamaki Collapsed?◆

dialogues.jp: 朝、待ち合わせの場所に環は来ない。
dialogues.en: Tamaki didn't meet me where we promised in the morning.
dialogues.text: Tamaki didn't meet me where we promised in the morning.

dialogues.jp: 心配になって神社に行くと、環が倒れている。
dialogues.en:
I searched for her at the shrine, worried, and saw her lying
on the floor, unconscious.
dialogues.text:
I searched for her at the shrine, worried, and saw her lying
on the floor, unconscious.

dialogues.jp:
俺は急いで救急車を呼び、一緒に救急車で病院
に行った。
dialogues.en:
I hurriedly called for an ambulance, and rode with her to
the hospital.
dialogues.text:
I hurriedly called for an ambulance, and rode with her to
the hospital.

dialogues.jp: どうして、こんなことに……。
dialogues.en: Why did this have to happen...
dialogues.text: Why did this have to happen...
